description: Unofficial fan-art Gundham Tanaka companion inspired by Danganronpa 2. Independently drawn animation features careful hamster-plush handling, a loose scarf shelter, paper-seed sorting, empty-bowl inspection, and original running and low-jump cycles. Hamsters are soft toys kept safely grounded during jumping. Compact proportions, props and choreography are original adaptations; no official affiliation.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
